title: Abbas ka Sar
body:
aale nabi ka khaafila bazaar jo pahuncha
chehre thay zard gham se saron par na thi rida
ghazi ka sar jo naize se aaya zameen par
fizza ne dil ko thaam ke nauha yehi kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
na dekh sakega zainab ko
haye be-chadar abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai naize par
dauran e safar abbas ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad se zainab kehti thi
manzar wo dekh na paungi
ye zulm hua to mere pisar
ro ro ke yahin mar jaungi
naaqe ke galay mein daal diya
zaalim ne agar abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
girti hai wo pusht e naaqa se
ye baar uthana mushkil hai
ammu se bhatiji ki ulfat
kya hai ye batana mushkil hai
naaqe pe sakina rukti nahi
aur naize par abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye zakhm kabhi bhar sakta nahi
bhulega dil e hassaas nahi
baba ki shahadat par roya
phir roya kabhi abbas nahi
karbal se yahan tak rota raha
har manzil par abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan se watan jaa kar bhi hum
aaram se kab so payenge
jab band karenge aankhon ko
manzar wo hamein tadpayenge
shabbir ka qasim o akbar ka
baysheer ka sar abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad batana chaahun agar
tujhse bhi nahi keh paaungi
kuch zakhm e jigar to aise hai
jo qabr talak le jaaungi
shabbir ka sar baazu mein rasan
akbar ka jigar abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
safdar wo qayamat ka manzar
likhte huwe mazhar rota tha
kehti thi behan aaja ghazi
aur shimr ye has kar kehta tha
kya teri madad ko aayega
ay nauhagar abbas ka sar
rukta hi nahi hai...
author: Mazhar Abidi
